activation: Existing validation_job boundary: intake remains open during current render, scheduler holds subsequent dispatch when trigger reaches terminal state
execute_via: same-conversation completion event; owner performs isolated sequential experiments after successful LAN delivery
prerequisites: LAN complete content SHA-256, geometry, frames and full software decode verified
no running jobs or worker processes
80 GiB inference and 88 GiB aggregate guard

stages.name: profile_representative_call_or_real_layer
stages.action: Torch profiler/Nsight if available: separate attention, H2D, FFN, LoRA and launch/synchronization; no full-video rerun

stages.name: frost_isolated_build_and_numerical_admission
check: whole representative output error against current baseline
last head and final K/V sentinel

stages.name: frost_warm_throughput
stages.action: Only numerically valid configurations: warmup then at least three interleaved repeats, CUDA event and wall-clock, memory peak; build/cold load excluded

stages.name: small_staging_prefetch
stages.condition: Only if real profile demonstrates material H2D idle time and buffer fits existing cap
stages.action: One/two layer pinned staging, independent copy stream/events; elementwise exact output gate; no whole-model double pinning

stages.name: graphs_output_cache
stages.action: Keep as low priority; only bounded experiment justified by measured bottleneck, no full rewrite

same_result_acceptance: Elementwise exact parity required before claiming same-result deployment; mathematical equivalence or high cosine alone is insufficient
completion_actions: release this maintenance only; do not override newer maintenance or OOM manual breaker
publish measured results and limitations in docs/Git
cancel_actions: remove only matching validation_job reservation or release only matching maintenance; leave current render untouched
